title: Find the Minimum Distance
learning_objective: Learn how to reduce all calculated point-pair distances down to the shortest one.

tutorial.explanation: After generating all unique pairs and calculating their distances, MIN picks the smallest distance. This is a common pattern: generate candidates first, then aggregate the candidates.
tutorial.mental_model: The pair-generation step creates the search space. MIN chooses the best candidate from that space.

guided_example.prompt: Find the shortest raw distance between any two points.
guided_example.solution_query: SELECT MIN(SQRT(POWER(p1.x - p2.x, 2) + POWER(p1.y - p2.y, 2))) AS shortest_distance FROM points p1 CROSS JOIN points p2 WHERE p1.id < p2.id;
guided_example.explanation: The formula calculates a distance for each unique pair. MIN returns the smallest value among those distances.

practice.prompt: Find the shortest distance between any two points, rounded to 2 decimals.
practice.expected_query: SELECT ROUND(MIN(SQRT(POWER(p1.x - p2.x, 2) + POWER(p1.y - p2.y, 2))), 2) AS shortest_distance FROM points p1 CROSS JOIN points p2 WHERE p1.id < p2.id;

hints: Start from the unique pair query.
Wrap the distance expression in MIN.
Round the final minimum distance to 2 decimals.
